notes: 10-K for fiscal 2010. The contents list (lines 45 to 73) is not labeled. Every Item from 1 to 15 has a body heading; the form had no Items 1C, 9C or 16 yet, so nothing is absent. Item 3 incorporates Note K but adds its own statement, and Item 7A points to the liquidity discussion in Item 7 but adds its own variable rate debt figures, so neither is marked. Item 4 '[Removed and Reserved]' has no body and is not marked. Items 1B, 9 and 9B ('None.') are nil answers, marked following the field definition in bench/src/labels.rs. Item 8 holds the statements and Schedules II to IV; Item 9A holds management's report and the auditors' report on internal control. Items 10, 11, 13 and 14 only incorporate the proxy statement (Item 10 also points to Item 1); Item 12 prints its own equity compensation plan table and is not marked. Item 15 holds the exhibit list and ends at the second SIGNATURES line (line 2339; the first is the contents entry), the filing end. Adjudicated from two independent labels, which agreed on every field.
